data.summary: The single black-outfit model steps forward, turns to a held back pose and clears her face after the hair gesture. The cut is late and the second shot is a tight face close-up, not the registered chest-up framing.

observations.text: Two forward step phases lead into the turn. The complete body remains inside the first-shot frame, with shoe tips and a grounded shadow visible beneath the wide trousers.
She turns to the back and holds while the fabric settles, then starts turning toward a side view again before the cut.

One cut reveals the same model with her right hand already over the near eye. The hand sweeps toward the ear and drops clear; the face ends unobscured with a slight smile. The top of the hair and chest are outside this tight close-up.
